name: Show Variations as Single Products for WooCommerce
author: theme funda

sections.description:
Show Variations as Single Products for WooCommerce lets you display each product variation as its own standalone product listing on your WooCommerce shop page, category pages, and product tag pages. Instead of forcing customers to click into a product detail page just to pick a size or color, they can browse, select, and add to cart directly from the listing — reducing friction and increasing conversions.

Whether you sell clothing, accessories, or any product with multiple variants, this plugin makes it simple for shoppers to find exactly what they’re looking for without extra clicks.

View Demo | Upgrade to Pro | Get Support

Why Use This Plugin?

Standard WooCommerce hides all variations behind a single parent product. This means customers must open each product page, choose their options, and then add to cart — an extra step that costs you sales. This plugin solves that by surfacing each variation as a standalone listing, making your shop faster to navigate and easier to buy from.

How to Get Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Settings > Woo Variation Settings.
  3. Enable the setting to show variations as single products.
  4. Save — your shop, category, and tag pages will now display individual variations.

Free Version Features

  • One-click setup — no coding required
  • Show product variations on the shop page, category pages, and product tag pages
  • Filter variations by product attribute
  • Customers can add variable products to cart directly from listing pages
  • Works with WooCommerce’s default product query
  • Supports both variation listings and standard single-product listings side by side

Pro Version Features

Upgrade to Pro for advanced control over exactly how and where variations appear:

  • Auto-hide parent variable products — show only the individual variations, not the parent
  • Hide parent product per individual product — granular control on a product-by-product basis
  • Exclude specific products from showing variations
  • Exclude entire product categories from the variation display
  • Custom display names for individual variation listings
  • Priority support

Get the Pro Version →

Works Great With

This plugin works alongside WooCommerce’s default product loop, including WooCommerce search results. When customers search your store, matching variations will appear as individual results — making it even easier to find the right product.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Show Variations as Single Products WooCommerce”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Navigate to Settings > Woo Variation Settings and enable the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to Settings > Woo Variation Settings and turn on the display options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

It works with any theme that uses WooCommerce’s default product loop and query. If your theme uses heavily customized product loops, some adjustments may be needed.

Will variations appear in WooCommerce search results?

Yes. When a customer searches your store, matching variations will appear as individual product results.

Can I show some variations but not others?

Yes. You can filter which variations appear using product attributes. The Pro version adds the ability to exclude specific products or categories entirely.

Can I hide the parent variable product and only show its variations?

This feature is available in the Pro version. It lets you auto-hide parent products so only the individual variations are visible in shop and category listings.

Does this affect the single product page?

No. The plugin only changes how products are displayed on listing pages (shop, category, and tag pages). The single product page remains unchanged.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Please check the plugin’s support forum or contact the developer for the latest compatibility information.
